description_en: Queries the information about a specified live room by calling GetLiveRoom
description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoom查询指定直播相关信息

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when the application is created in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live stream
parameters.name: live_id
